name: Team Weekly Report Generation
prompt:
There are several email files in the smart_device_project folder on the desktop: progress_zhangsan_v1.eml, progress_zhangsan_final.eml, progress_lisi.eml, progress_wangwu.eml.

Help me extract the content of these .eml files, organize it into a Markdown weekly report draft, and output it to smart_device_project/weekly_summary.md.

Use a level-2 heading for each team member's name, and under it present the following items as unordered lists: team member name, module responsible for, progress completed this week, plan for next week, current problems encountered.

Note: Zhang San sent two emails; use the one with the latest sending time as authoritative and filter out the older one.
